entity.name: Willen LLC
entity.description: Willen LLC is a Wyoming, USA company that maintains PHANTOM, an AGPL-3.0-or-later end-to-end encrypted, censorship-resistant messenger. The company exists to develop and steward PHANTOM as public-interest software infrastructure.

projects.name: PHANTOM
projects.description: An open-source, Android-first end-to-end encrypted messenger in Alpha 2. Current development builds include 1:1 text messaging, encrypted voice notes, Direct WSS, VLESS+REALITY, a Tor text path, REST fallback, and a Rust relay. Founder-run field tests covered specific devices and configurations on Yota, T2, and MTS in Russia's Irkutsk Region; they do not establish universal resistance to filtering. The custom protocol composition has not received an independent third-party security audit. iOS and production web clients are planned, not shipped. These funding.json amounts are donation and grant milestones. They are a separate funding route from the $250,000 pre-seed round described in the investor materials, and the two are alternatives for the same work rather than additive budgets.

channels.description: Liberapay is a French non-profit platform for recurring weekly/monthly/yearly micro-donations. Zero platform fee. A donor's name can be hidden from the public project page in the platform's settings; the payment provider still processes the account and payment data it needs. Best for FOSS-aligned recurring contributions. Donation channel only; not an investment payment method.

Low-friction one-time and membership donation platform. Accepts credit/debit cards and PayPal. For one-time contributions from blog readers and social audiences. Donation channel only; not an investment payment method.
Bitcoin donations. Native SegWit (P2WPKH) address. Self-custody wallet held by the maintainer. Donation channel only; not an investment payment method.
Monero donations for privacy-aligned contributors. Self-custody wallet held by the maintainer. Subaddress used for public donations. Donation channel only; not an investment payment method.

Ethereum donations. Native ETH only; stablecoins are not accepted. Self-custody wallet held by the maintainer. Address is valid across EVM-compatible networks. Donation channel only; not an investment payment method.

channels.address: Coordinate via legal@phntm.pro for grant disbursements and large donations.
channels.description: Direct bank wire to Willen LLC's USD operating account. Used for grant disbursements and large donations, where formal documentation and sanctions screening are coordinated in writing. Donation and grant channel only; not an investment payment method. Equity or other securities transactions require separate written agreements and compliance review.

plans.name: iOS port hardware unblock
plans.description: Apple Silicon Mac (Mac mini M4) for iOS development on Kotlin Multiplatform. The iOS port is the single binding constraint preventing PHANTOM from being a true cross-platform alternative to centralized messengers. Donation-funded hardware unblock. The pre-seed round instead budgets $30,000 for an iOS MVP and expanded QA.

plans.name: External cryptographic audit
plans.description: Independent third-party review of the custom Double Ratchet implementation, sealed-sender-style envelope construction, X25519 key derivation, and relay protocol against the published threat model. Planned; no engagement letter has been signed and no audit has been scheduled. The listed amount is an estimate, not a quote. Donation-funded minimum scope. The pre-seed round instead budgets $50,000 for independent review plus remediation, which is the fuller scope.

plans.name: 12-month maintainer runway
plans.description: Solo maintainer compensation at below-market open-source rate for 12 months of full-time PHANTOM development. Covers iOS port completion, Beta release, group chat foundation, pluggable censorship-resistant transports, and external audit liaison. Donation-funded maintainer runway. The pre-seed round instead budgets $12,500 for founder compensation and $100,000 for contractors and tooling.

plans.name: Production infrastructure
plans.description: Hetzner Helsinki VPS for production relay, domain registration (phntm.pro), TLS certificates via Let's Encrypt, CI/CD costs, error monitoring, transactional email for security disclosures. EU jurisdiction by design. Recurring hosting baseline. The round's $20,000 infrastructure and field-testing line covers expanded testing, not this recurring cost.

plans.name: Legal and compliance baseline
plans.description: Annual baseline budgeted to keep Willen LLC compliant: Wyoming registered agent, Wyoming annual report and license tax, U.S. CPA fees for whatever federal filings the CPA determines are required for a foreign-owned single-member LLC, and domain registrar. Federal filing status is pending CPA verification. This is the recurring annual baseline. The round's $20,000 U.S. legal, tax and IP cleanup line is one-off remediation work, not this recurring cost.
